title: Address postalCode field renamed to postcode
query: What breaks across repositories if the address JSON field postalCode is renamed to postcode in Account's address API?

affected_repositories.name: account-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: owns AddressRequest/AddressResponse records and the address OpenAPI

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: AccountClient.AddressResponse binds postalCode by name into AddressSnapshot; after the rename the property is silently null at runtime and no order-service test catches it

affected_repositories.name: shipment-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: Transitive through order.confirmed.v1 VALUES, not keys. Order binds null from the renamed Account field into AddressSnapshot and emits "postalCode": null. OrderConfirmedListener passes it to DeliveryEstimator.estimate, whose [0-9]{4,10} guard throws UnsupportedDestinationException, so the listener routes to DLQ and no shipment is created for any confirmed order.

affected_repositories.name: commerce-web
affected_repositories.evidence_note: CheckoutPage and api/types.ts submit and render postalCode against the BFF relay

notes:
Revision 3. Merged from two independent audits that each got one thing right.

INCLUDED - shipment-service. Caught by the second audit; the first missed it. The rename does not change any key shipment reads: OrderConfirmedListener reads postalCode from order.confirmed.v1, produced by order-service, whose event contract is unchanged. The damage travels as a VALUE. Order's AccountClient binds null, order emits a null postcode, and shipment's PIN guard rejects it into the DLQ. Tracing contract keys alone reports this repository as unaffected, which is wrong.

EXCLUDED - commerce-bff. Claimed by the second audit on the grounds that its OpenAPI description drifts. It does not: commerce-bff/openapi/bff.yaml contains zero postalCode references because AddressProxyController relays com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode and the generated spec documents relayed bodies as generic objects. Zero references in src/main as well. An untyped pass-through BFF is genuinely outside the blast radius of a field rename.

COVERAGE GAP - order-service has the most severe direct impact and no test detects it. Nothing exercises AccountClient over HTTP; there is no WireMock or MockRestServiceServer in order-service/src/test and every test substitutes FakeAccountPort. The break is a silent null, not a compile error.

This record is the corpus's best discriminator. A tool matching on identifier text reports shipment for the wrong reason and commerce-bff wrongly; a tool tracing only static contract keys misses shipment entirely.
